quest.title: Were It So Easy
quest.description: The troubles of Cosanzeana the little florist continue...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: #Ah, it's {NICKNAME} and Paimon, the bringers of exotic flowers!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, Cosanzeana. Have the flowers we brought been growing well?

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: Um, about that... I haven't gone to look at them for a whole day...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Didn't you like the flowers? Why aren't you looking after them?

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: Ohh... They were so hard to get, so I do want to take good care of them, so, so much... But when I think that they might wither before my eyes, I... I'm scared to go...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh wow, you really are very concerned about them... Why don't we go have a look together? If anything bad happens, we'll help you out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's no point in worrying too much.

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: You're right... Let's go together! With the two of you to help me, I feel like we can handle this!

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: #Awesome, {NICKNAME}! You turned that ugly machine into beautiful components — "kabam," just like that!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, it won't be troubling this garden again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Some of the flowers have been damaged, but the rest still look like they're in good shape. There shouldn't be any Breacher Primuses coming around to trouble your garden again, so your flowers can now grow strong and healthy!

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: This is great... Still, I've learned my lesson. Such precious flowers require attentive care and diligent protection.

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon... You've brought me such exotic flowers, and you've even helped me defend my garden. How can I ever repay you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, no need to be so polite about it!

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, I know! I picked these flowers myself — they're very precious to me! Can I give them to you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh! Um, if these flowers really are that precious, then you should probably start your own garden to plant them in, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, uh, aren't these Tidalga? Do they really count as flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: Tidalga are plants, and they are very beautiful, so of course they're flowers. This is what humans call "biology" — I've spent some time studying it so that I can become a great florist in the future. Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon feels like there's something kinda off about this, but it's not like Paimon knows too much about plant taxonomy either...

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: I'll continue to work hard towards my goal. I've heard humans say that excellent florists are able to breed new types of flowers, which they then bring to "horticultural fairs."

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: I want to do that, too — and I want to win "awards" there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's very commendable and everything, but Paimon feels like there are still some misunderstandings here that will be hard to explain...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Her purpose for taking part in a horticultural fair is to show off the new varieties of plants she's made and let humans appreciate them, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The thing is, her senses and aesthetics might be a bit too different from those of humans... Do you think they might find the flowers she breeds... weird?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're rather invested in her horticultural career, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course! Paimon's her teacher, you know. If she wins, Paimon'll look good too!

choices.text: There's no need to be too obsessed with winning awards. The most important thing is to be happy with your work.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true. The only person who needs to find the flowers you raise beautiful is you! You don't have to worry too much about what other people think.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You just need to take care of your garden, watch the lovely flowers, and be happy every day!

response.speaker: Cosanzeana
response.text: Yes! I'll make sure they grow up healthy and strong!

choices.text: You've taken your first step toward success.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true. The varieties you come up with will probably be pretty unique, but some people will like that kinda thing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Once you finish breeding a new variety, make sure you tell us first, alright?

response.speaker: Cosanzeana
response.text: Of course! You've helped me so much, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: Ah, my flowers from a distant land~ May you grow quickly, tall may you stand~

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: *sob* My precious flowers... They've been ruined...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, what a pity... So the reason your flowers couldn't grow is because of the damage done by the Breacher Primus?

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: ...I ... I'm going to keep watch next to my flowers from now on! I'm never leaving again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, calm down for a second, Cosanzeana. Let's think of another solution together. First off, why would the Breacher Primus damage your flower garden?

choices.text: When you brought other flowers back before...

response.speaker: Cosanzeana
response.text: No, never! Hmph, that bad guy would only dare do such things behind my back. Ooh, now I'm really mad!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, uh, Paimon didn't expect Cosanzeana could also get so angry. Guess she really does care a lot about these flowers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But thinking back for a moment, it's not like the Primuses ran away once she got close...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Perhaps it's not the flowers that are attracting them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's possible. Let's check the area around the garden and see what we can find!

choices.text: Did any Breacher Primuses come after you?

talks.objective: Look for clues in the area

dialogues.speaker: Cosanzeana
dialogues.text: My garden... Why did that bad guy want to destroy my garden...
